name: banking77_v8
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which one intent does it express? Pick the single most specific intent. When a fee or problem names its source (top-up, cash withdrawal, transfer, card payment, exchange), prefer that source's label.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card that has arrived: how to activate it, or the activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum/maximum age to open or use an account; accounts for children or teenagers.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where the nearest ATM is, which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic (auto) top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer's OWN balance does not reflect a bank transfer (sent or received): 'I transferred money but the balance is the same', 'money transferred to me isn't showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money the customer deposited (cash or cheque) that has not shown up in the balance yet, or is slow.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add or pay a beneficiary / payee, or is suddenly told a transfer to someone is not possible or not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling, reversing or reverting a transfer/payment/transaction the customer made (wrong account, no longer needed).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired: getting a replacement, what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used / is accepted (shops, countries, merchants).
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was sent but has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, getting it by a certain date, express/fast-tracked delivery.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card (an existing card or new card) to the account in the app; making a card show in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card itself is generically faulty/unusable, esp. across several places or attempts, with no decline or rejection wording.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra amount the customer ties to paying by card / making a purchase with the card.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: An unknown, strange or wrong payment/charge on the statement that the customer did not make or does not recognise ('I have an unknown charge', 'I don't know what this charge is for').
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees for withdrawing or getting cash at an ATM, including unexpected fees after taking cash out.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Someone else may be using the card or card details (fraud, copied card, strange card payments), wanting it blocked. If the problem is a cash withdrawal they did not make, use cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or cards are available in; whether customers outside the UK / in a given country can get an account or card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A specific card payment/purchase framed as declined, rejected or not going through (in a shop or online).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or not authorised.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account the customer does not recognise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details (name, address, information) on the account.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are, where to find them.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Whether or how the customer can exchange money using the app, e.g. 'Can I exchange USD for GBP in the app?', 'Am I able to exchange some of my money?'.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: The customer asks why they were charged extra, or about a small charge of a specific amount like $1 or £1 on the statement. Without 'extra' or a small amount, an unknown charge is card_payment_not_recognised.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or keeps failing / cannot be made.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding or exchange, e.g. 'are you able to make exchanges to EUR?', 'what currencies do you support?'.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting a disposable virtual card: who can get one, how.
criteria.get_physical_card: The card PIN: where to find it, how to get or set a PIN for the card, PIN not received.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting or finding a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is lost or stolen, or a lost card was found; freezing/blocking a lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone is lost, stolen or left behind; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wanting or getting a physical card: how/where to get or order one, its cost, where cards can be delivered.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten app passcode or login code; resetting it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase that is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; what a pending payment means.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal that is pending / in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up (not a deposit) that is pending or taking a long time.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer explicitly described as pending, in progress or not yet cleared.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card/account is blocked after too many wrong PIN attempts; unblocking it.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others: can someone send me money, salary, currencies accepted when receiving.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Asking how to get a refund for something bought.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment that came back / was returned or reverted to the customer's account, e.g. money deducted for a purchase then back in the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (brands like American Express, Visa, Mastercard) and currencies are accepted for adding money, including why a particular card brand doesn't work for top-up.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up that did not go through, failed, was declined, or whose money is gone after a failed attempt.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much or how often to top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up that went through (the customer saw the money) but was later reverted, cancelled or the money disappeared from the account.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card (explicit top-up wording).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: A payment charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to add/transfer money into the account (including using a credit card to transfer money in), or being unable to.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent to someone (a friend, landlord, retailer, another account) has not arrived or completed, even when phrased as 'how long does it take?' or 'will I have to wait longer?'.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take, or how much longer the customer has to wait for their transfer, when no recipient is said to be missing the money.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failing or not possible.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: showing or verifying where the money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for it; the verification code for a top-up or card transfer.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave less (or different) cash than requested/charged.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.
